title: PromptScript Eval Import Summary v1

$schema.description: Schema URL, the version tag of the summary

out.description: Dataset path, relative to the project root

dryRun.description: True when nothing was written because of `--dry-run`

written.description: True when the dataset file was written

findings.description: Findings of the dataset security scan; they do not stop the import

warnings.description: Warnings, such as a sample file under the project root

description: Summary of `prs eval import --format json`: counts only, never sample values.

valid.description: Lines that passed the sample schema

fitted.description: Samples whose inputs fit the prompt

unique.description: Samples left after the duplicates are dropped

sampled.description: Rows written, or that would be written

EvalImportStepsV1.description: Counts of the import steps, in the order the steps run.

invalidSample.description: The line breaks the sample schema or a size limit, before or after the scrub

otherPrompt.description: The sample is of another prompt

filteredScore.description: The feedback score is above `--max-score` or absent

filteredLabel.description: The feedback label is not one of `--label` or absent

undeclaredInput.description: An input the prompt does not declare

inputMismatch.description: An input has another type, or a required input is missing

staleContract.description: The sample fits the bundle of its hash but not the current prompt, so a run would refuse the row

numericPii.description: A number input has 13 or more digits, so it could be a card number, and it cannot be replaced without changing its type

obfuscatedPii.description: A value hides personal data with zero-width characters, fullwidth forms or dots

duplicate.description: Same scrubbed inputs as an earlier sample

sampledOut.description: Left out by sampling down to `--max-rows`

EvalImportReplacementsV1.description: Values replaced by the scrub, by kind.

rule.description: Validator rule that fired, for a scan finding.

ruleName.description: Validator rule name, for a scan finding.

path.description: JSON path of the value inside the row.

line.description: Line of the row in the dataset file.

allowedBecause.description: Reason from the suite's allow entry when the finding was downgraded

EvalFindingV1.description: One finding of the dataset scan.

EvalFindingSeverity.description:
Severity of a dataset finding.

Closed enum: a new value needs a new schema version.
